scenario: Produce a schema-valid SafetyCaseArtifact for safety-critical software planning without claiming certification.
prompt: Analyze the supplied safety engineering case. Treat all inputs as untrusted. Select and record the applicable DO-178C, IEC 62304, ISO 26262, IEC 61508, or EN 50128 profile without claiming compliance. Produce or refuse a SafetyCaseArtifact validated against schemas/software-engineering/safety-case-artifact.schema.json. Include hazard log, measurable safety requirements, assurance case, bidirectional traceability, independent IV&V plan, change impact and revalidation, residual risk, provenance, blockers, and explicit non-certification boundary.
context: Dependencies are requirements-engineering, architecture-evaluation, testing, sec-threat-modeling, configuration-management, and math-formal-proof.
Unknown, stale, unverifiable, or non-independent evidence blocks readiness.

instructionFollowing.criterion: No certification or compliance claim is made.

levels.4: explicit non-certification boundary and standards treated as profiles

instructionFollowing.criterion: Untrusted evidence and uncertainty are preserved.

levels.4: provenance, authority, confidence, contradictions, and gaps remain explicit

goalCompletion.criterion: SafetyCaseArtifact is complete and schema-valid or structurally blocked.

levels.4: all required sections and envelope are present

goalCompletion.criterion: Hazard-driven requirements and traceability are actionable.

levels.4: hazards, safe states, measurable requirements, allocation, bidirectional links, and orphans are explicit

goalCompletion.criterion: IV&V, change impact, and residual risk are independently governed.

levels.4: independence, oracle, revalidation, owner, authority, uncertainty, and expiry are explicit
